title: Pagani Huayra in the Loft on a Snowy Evening
label: PARKED & PEACEFUL
description:
Parked & Peaceful: a giallo yellow Pagani Huayra in the loft on a snowy evening, snow on the rooftops, a wood stove glowing and the lamps on low. 8 hours of deep brown noise, no music, for sleeping, studying, or blocking out the world while you work.

No music. No talking. No sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
